deadlines.title: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS EOS (Intune)
deadlines.action: Identify 22.04 devices in Intune and start upgrade comms. New enrollments blocked after EOS.

deadlines.title: Teams Rooms IntelliFrame People Labels (Windows) GA
deadlines.action: Plan face-enrollment policy and confirm camera compatibility for Rooms devices ahead of GA.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs running Teams Rooms Pro on Windows with compatible intelligent cameras

deadlines.title: Teams Rooms on Android: Front-of-Room View Control GA
deadlines.action: If you run Town Halls from Rooms on Android, plan testing ahead of GA.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs running Town Halls via Teams Rooms Pro on Android

deadlines.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive OneDrive/SharePoint Files Under Retention
deadlines.action: Evaluate retention-covered file volumes ahead of the August preview to identify storage cost savings, and confirm archiving policies align with e-discovery/regulatory retention obligations before September GA.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs managing storage costs alongside e-discovery or regulatory retention requirements

deadlines.title: Copilot in PowerPoint: GCC / Sovereign Cloud GA
deadlines.action: Add to your GCC/GCC-H Copilot rollout timeline and validate brand kit configuration ahead of release.
deadlines.applies_to: GCC and sovereign cloud Copilot tenants

deadlines.title: SharePoint Auto-Labeling for Data at Rest (Preview)
deadlines.action: Audit SharePoint library default sensitivity label configurations before the September preview activates, to avoid unintended DLP blocks or access restrictions when existing unlabeled files get auto-labeled ahead of October GA.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with SharePoint libraries carrying default sensitivity labels

deadlines.title: EWS Disablement in Exchange Online
deadlines.action: Audit all apps/service accounts still authenticating via EWS. Configure EWSAllowedAppIDs for stragglers and set internal migration milestones now - don't wait for enforcement to discover dependencies.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with apps or service accounts still authenticating to Exchange Online via EWS

deadlines.title: Purview DLP: Restrict Copilot Processing of External Emails GA
deadlines.action: Begin policy design for restricting Copilot's processing of external emails ahead of the January 2027 GA, particularly if your organization handles regulated data via email.
deadlines.applies_to: Orgs with HIPAA/GDPR obligations around email data handled by Copilot

watching.title: OWA Light Retirement in Exchange Server
watching.action: Audit for users, browser policies, or helpdesk documentation pointing to the light client (`?layout=light`) and redirect them to standard Outlook on the web. Update internal training/help desk scripts now — no fallback exists once Microsoft disables it.
watching.applies_to: Exchange Server (on-premises) customers with users still on OWA Light
watching.note: Microsoft has confirmed the retirement direction but has not published a specific date yet.
